notes: Static-shell SPA on cPanel: no robots.txt, sitemap.xml, OG, JSON-LD, or prerender; single canonical=https://site00.com/ on all routes; admin/control routes indexable. EVOLVE marketing OS is real (Supabase, admin-guarded, tested) but scoped to 5 hard-coded orgs. Client marketing engagement exposes self-serve confirm-payment/provision (blocker). Email renders but never sends (blocker for client notifications). Unauthenticated founder endpoints in this domain: api/site00/campaign-package.ts (incl. delete_asset_permanent) and api/site00/expression-engine.ts (incl. live-job start). Several 'production' stores are memory-only by construction (dailyPublishingCadence, liveCulturalIntelligence, marketingCampaignProduction, existingLocation, contentBrain). Publishing is fully fenced; analytics adapters return []. REFINE/INSTALL/TRANSFORM exist only as copy + localStorage assessment; no delivery workflow. Most content tooling is Ndxbook-specific.
